answer.traditional: 他拿著錢包想：付了房租以後，錢還剩多少？
answer.simplified: 他拿着钱包想：付了房租以后，钱还剩多少？
answer.pinyin: Tā názhe qiánbāo xiǎng: Fù le fángzū yǐhòu, qián hái shèng duōshǎo?
answer.english: Holding his wallet, he wonders: after paying the rent, how much money will be left?

questions.why: 剩 means to be left over: he is working out how much money he will have left after the rent. 租 (to rent) and 收 (to collect) don't make sense after 錢還.

prompt.traditional: 床和書桌＿＿都很新。
prompt.simplified: 床和书桌＿＿都很新。

answer.traditional: 床和書桌看起來都很新。
answer.simplified: 床和书桌看起来都很新。
answer.pinyin: Chuáng hé shūzhuō kànqǐlái dōu hěn xīn.

She also often drops leftover food on the floor and makes the room so dirty that there are little bugs everywhere. text.traditional: 我跟室友住在學校外面的一間公寓。室友很會做菜，常常做很多好吃的東西請我吃。可是她每次做完飯，都把廚房弄得很亂，碗筷也不洗，總是說明天再洗。上個週末，我們討論了很久，決定以後她做飯，我洗碗。現在廚房乾淨多了，我也常常有好吃的菜可以吃。

Kěshì tā měi cì zuò wán fàn, dōu bǎ chúfáng nòng de hěn luàn, wǎnkuài yě bù xǐ, zǒngshì shuō míngtiān zài xǐ. Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒmen tǎolùn le hěn jiǔ, juédìng yǐhòu tā zuòfàn, wǒ xǐ wǎn. text.simplified: 我哥哥上个月搬家了。他的新房子很大，可是以前住在那里的人在墙上乱画，把墙弄得很脏，所以哥哥搬进去以前，得先把墙弄干净。哥哥不想自己弄，就请了两个工人来帮忙。工人工作了两天，把墙弄得跟新的一样。现在哥哥很满意，还请我们去他家吃饭。

Tā de xīn fángzi hěn dà, kěshì yǐqián zhù zài nàlǐ de rén zài qiáng shàng luàn huà, bǎ qiáng nòng de hěn zāng, suǒyǐ gēge bān jìnqù yǐqián, děi xiān bǎ qiáng nòng gānjìng. Gēge bù xiǎng zìjǐ nòng, jiù qǐng le liǎng ge gōngrén lái bāngmáng. Gōngrén gōngzuò le liǎng tiān, bǎ qiáng nòng de gēn xīn de yíyàng. Xiànzài gēge hěn mǎnyì, hái qǐng wǒmen qù tā jiā chīfàn.

His new place is big, but the people who lived there before had scribbled all over the walls and made them dirty, so before moving in he had to get the walls cleaned. He didn't want to do it himself, so he hired two workers to help. They worked for two days and made the walls as good as new. text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zài Táiběi gōngzuò. Tā yǐqián zhù zài gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le, kěshì fángzū hěn guì. Qùnián tā bān dào lí Táiběi bǐjiào yuǎn de dìfāng, fángzū bǐ yǐqián piányí yíbàn, fángzi yě bǐ yǐqián dà. Suīrán xiànzài měitiān děi zuò sìshí fēnzhōng de jiéyùn shàngbān, kěshì tā juéde zài jiéyùn shàng kěyǐ kàn shū, tīng yīnyuè, yě búcuò.
text.english: My older sister works in Taipei. She used to live near her office, a ten-minute walk away, but the rent was high. Last year she moved somewhere farther from Taipei; the rent is half what it was, and the place is bigger too. Although she now takes the MRT for forty minutes to work every day, she thinks it's not bad, since she can read and listen to music on the train.
